title: Form the deal or fund entity
summary: Form the entity that raises the money and owns the property, and get its tax id and bank account in place.
outlineSteps: Confirm the structure and entity type decided with counsel
Confirm the manager or general partner entity that will control it
Choose the entity's state with counsel to fit the offering
Form the entity before any subscription is accepted
Open the entity's bank account with named signers
Require a second person to approve every outgoing wire
Have the account open before any wiring instructions go out
Keep the entity's money and records apart from the sponsor's and other deals'
